x: Nevertheless, with only three weeks running under his belt, Rich turned out to support his team. 7.5 miles. 1 J Blackledge (Oxford/Belgrave) 38:07; 2 P Natali (Cambridge/Italy); 3 F Thompson (Oxford/Aldershot F&D); 4 B Moreau (Oxford/Aldershot F&D); 16 R Ward (Cambridge/Belgrave) 43:46.

Three weeks off with a foot injury meant that Richard Ward’s return to fitness had been delayed somewhat but his decision to tackle the relay gave the team a boost and as Dorking dropped away Rich held us steady in second.

Rich has more sub-15 performances than any Belgravian except Jonathan Blackledge – but he didn’t enjoy this outing! Salford had extended their lead through Tomas Abyu and the Beagles were up to 2nd but it was Birchfield heading the field after three stages as Salford slipped out of contention.
